General Services

What makes Lumyx different from other digital marketing agencies in Tampa?

Unlike other Tampa digital marketing agencies, we're so confident in our approach that if you don't see measurable improvements in your marketing ROI within 90 days, we'll refund every penny. We specialize in data-driven PPC management services, advanced SEO strategies, and conversion optimization. Our clients see an average 312% revenue increase because we focus on measurable results, not just vanity metrics. See our case studies for proof. We also provide weekly transparent reporting and treat every client as a true partner, not just another account number.

Do you work with businesses outside of Tampa?

Yes! While we're based in the Tampa Bay area, we serve clients nationwide. Our digital marketing services work for any business looking to grow online, regardless of location. We have successful clients across Florida, the US, and internationally. Our remote-first approach means we can deliver the same high-quality results whether you're in Tampa, New York, or anywhere else.

What industries do you specialize in?

We work with businesses across all industries, with particular expertise in healthcare, legal services, e-commerce, professional services, and home services. Our strategies are customized for each industry's unique challenges and customer behavior patterns. We've successfully scaled businesses in SaaS, real estate, automotive, fitness, beauty, and many other sectors.

What size businesses do you typically work with?

We work with businesses of all sizes, from startups and small businesses to mid-market and enterprise companies. Our sweet spot is businesses generating $500K-$10M annually who are ready to scale. We customize our approach based on your current revenue, growth goals, and marketing budget. Whether you're just starting or looking to scale to 7-8 figures, we have proven strategies for your stage.

How quickly can you start working on my account?

We can typically start within 5-7 business days after our initial strategy call and contract signing. For urgent situations, we offer expedited onboarding within 48-72 hours. The timeline depends on account access, campaign complexity, and whether we're taking over existing campaigns or starting from scratch. We prioritize getting results fast while ensuring everything is set up correctly for long-term success.

PPC Management

How much do your PPC management services cost?

Our PPC management services start at $2,500/month, which includes Google Ads management, keyword research, landing page optimization, and detailed reporting. We also manage your ad spend separately and optimize for maximum ROI. Most clients see 3-5x return on their investment within the first 60 days. The exact cost depends on your industry, competition level, and campaign complexity.

What platforms do you manage PPC campaigns on?

We manage PPC campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads (Bing), Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and YouTube Ads. We select the best platforms based on your target audience, budget, and business goals. Google Ads typically provides the highest intent traffic, while social platforms excel for brand awareness and retargeting.

How quickly can I see results from PPC campaigns?

PPC campaigns can start generating traffic immediately once approved (usually within 24-48 hours). However, optimization for best results typically takes 2-4 weeks as we gather data and refine targeting. Most clients see significant improvements in cost-per-acquisition and ROI within 30-60 days of campaign launch.

What's your average return on ad spend (ROAS)?

Our clients typically see 3-5x ROAS on Google Ads and 4-8x ROAS on Facebook/Instagram ads, though results vary by industry and competition level. E-commerce clients often achieve higher ROAS (5-10x), while lead generation campaigns focus more on cost-per-lead metrics. We focus on profitable scaling—not just vanity metrics—ensuring your ad spend translates to actual revenue growth.

Do you manage the ad budget or do I?

You control your ad budget and pay platforms directly (Google, Facebook, etc.). We manage how that budget is spent—optimizing bids, targeting, ad creative, and campaign strategy. This keeps your costs transparent and means we don't mark up ad spend. We recommend starting with $2,000-$5,000/month minimum for most platforms to gather sufficient data, though this varies by industry and goals.

Can you take over my existing PPC campaigns?

Absolutely! We specialize in account audits and takeovers. We'll conduct a thorough analysis of your current campaigns, identify what's working and what's wasting budget, then implement improvements immediately. Most takeover clients see 30-50% improvement in performance within the first 60 days just from better optimization and account structure.

AI Lead Gen & Booking Agents

What are AI booking agents and how do they work?

AI booking agents are automated systems that capture, qualify, and book leads 24/7 without human intervention. When a lead fills out a form or contacts you, our AI agent responds instantly via SMS or email, asks qualifying questions, answers common FAQs, and books qualified prospects directly into your calendar. They work around the clock, even while you sleep or focus on running your business.

Why does lead response speed matter so much?

Speed is critical in lead conversion. Studies show that leads contacted within 5 minutes are 24% more likely to convert compared to just 1% conversion rate when you wait 30 minutes. Most business owners are busy with operations, customers, and growth—they can't respond to every lead instantly. That's where our AI agents excel: they respond in seconds, every single time, capturing opportunities that would otherwise be lost.

What kind of workflows can AI agents handle?

Our AI agents handle complete lead-to-booking workflows including: instant lead capture and response, lead qualification through smart questions, FAQ answering, appointment scheduling and calendar management, automated reminders to reduce no-shows, follow-up sequences for nurturing, re-engagement of stale leads, and CRM updates and tagging. All workflows are customized to your business needs and integrate seamlessly with your existing tools.

What systems do AI agents integrate with?

We integrate with all major business tools including: Calendar systems (Calendly, Google Calendar, Outlook), CRM platforms (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce), Communication channels (SMS, email, website chat widgets), Advertising platforms (Meta/Facebook Ads, Google Ads), and Website forms and lead capture tools. We plug into your existing tech stack so there's minimal disruption to your current processes.

How long does it take to deploy AI agents?

Typical deployment takes 3-14 days depending on complexity. We start with a discovery call to map your funnel, identify drop-off points, and design your workflow. Then we configure your AI agent, connect it to your calendar, CRM, and messaging channels. Once testing is complete, your agent goes live and starts capturing leads 24/7. We handle all setup, integration, and ongoing optimization.

How much do AI booking agents cost?

We offer three packages: Starter (inbound agent + Calendly integration with basic follow-ups), Pro (multi-channel agents with advanced qualification, CRM updates, and no-show recovery), and Enterprise (custom workflows, white-label deployment, and dedicated support). Pricing varies based on your needs, but most businesses see 2-5x more booked calls and a positive ROI within the first month. Book a free demo to see pricing tailored to your business.

Will AI agents sound robotic or impersonal?

Not at all! We train our AI agents to match your brand voice and communication style. They can be professional, friendly, casual, or formal—whatever fits your business. The conversations feel natural and helpful, not robotic. Plus, leads care more about getting instant answers than whether it's a human or AI. The key is speed and helpfulness, which our agents deliver perfectly.

SEO Services

How long does it take to see results from SEO services?

SEO results typically begin showing within 3-6 months, with significant improvements by month 6-12. However, our technical SEO optimizations can improve site speed and user experience immediately. We also combine SEO with PPC for faster initial results while organic rankings build. Local SEO for Tampa businesses often shows results faster, within 2-4 months.

What's included in your SEO services?

Our SEO services include technical SEO audits, keyword research, on-page optimization, content creation, link building, local SEO (for Tampa and Florida businesses), and monthly reporting. We also optimize for Core Web Vitals, mobile responsiveness, and user experience factors that Google considers for rankings.

Do you guarantee first page rankings?

We don't guarantee specific rankings because Google's algorithm is constantly changing and no ethical SEO agency can guarantee rankings. However, we do guarantee improved organic traffic, better search visibility, and increased leads from SEO within 6 months, or we'll continue working at no additional cost until you see results.

How much does SEO cost per month?

Our SEO services range from $2,000-$5,000/month depending on your market competition, website size, and goals. This includes technical SEO, content creation, link building, and monthly reporting. Local SEO for Tampa-area businesses starts at $1,500/month. Unlike PPC, SEO is a long-term investment that builds compounding results over time, often delivering the best ROI after 6-12 months.

What's the difference between local SEO and regular SEO?

Local SEO focuses on ranking for location-specific searches (e.g., "digital marketing agency Tampa") and optimizing your Google Business Profile, local citations, and reviews. Regular SEO targets broader, national keywords. If you serve customers in a specific geographic area, local SEO is critical. We excel at both and will recommend the right strategy based on your business model and target customers.

Do you write content for my website?

Yes! High-quality content is essential for SEO success. We create blog posts, service pages, landing pages, and other content optimized for both search engines and your target audience. All content is original, researched, and designed to establish your authority while ranking for valuable keywords. We typically produce 2-4 pieces of content per month as part of our SEO packages.

Social Media & Web Development

Do you offer social media marketing services?

Yes, we provide complete social media marketing services including Facebook advertising, Instagram marketing, LinkedIn campaigns, and organic social media management. We focus on platforms that drive the best ROI for your specific business and target audience. Our social media ads typically achieve 3-6x ROAS.

Do you provide website development services?

Absolutely! We create conversion-optimized websites, e-commerce stores, and landing pages that are designed to turn visitors into customers. All our websites are mobile-responsive, fast-loading, and optimized for search engines. We also provide ongoing maintenance and optimization to ensure peak performance.

How much does a new website cost?

Website costs vary based on complexity and features. A basic business website starts at $5,000, while e-commerce sites typically range from $10,000-$25,000. This includes design, development, mobile optimization, basic SEO setup, and 3 months of support. We also offer payment plans to make our services accessible to growing businesses.

How long does it take to build a website?

A standard business website typically takes 4-6 weeks from kickoff to launch. E-commerce sites take 6-10 weeks due to additional complexity like product setup, payment integration, and inventory management. Rush projects can be completed in 2-3 weeks for an additional fee. Timeline depends on content availability, feedback turnaround, and the number of pages/features required.

Do you offer website maintenance and updates?

Yes! We offer ongoing website maintenance packages starting at $200/month, which include security updates, plugin updates, content changes, performance monitoring, and technical support. This ensures your website stays secure, fast, and up-to-date. We also provide emergency support for critical issues that arise outside business hours.

What platforms do you build websites on?

We primarily build on WordPress and Shopify, depending on your needs. WordPress is perfect for content-heavy sites and offers maximum flexibility. Shopify is ideal for e-commerce stores with its powerful built-in features. We also work with custom HTML/CSS/JavaScript solutions for unique requirements. We'll recommend the best platform based on your goals, budget, and technical comfort level.

Pricing & Process

What's included in your free strategy call?

Our free 30-minute strategy call includes a competitor analysis, identification of immediate opportunities, a custom revenue roadmap, and 3 quick-win strategies you can implement immediately. We'll also provide a detailed proposal for ongoing services if it's a good fit. There's no pressure or sales pitch - just valuable insights you can use right away.

Do you require long-term contracts?

We typically recommend 6-month agreements for best results, but we don't lock clients into long-term contracts. Our goal is to deliver such exceptional results that you want to continue working with us. Most clients stay with us for years because of the consistent ROI we deliver, not because of contractual obligations.

How do you measure and report results?

We provide detailed monthly reports showing key metrics like traffic growth, lead generation, conversion rates, ROI, and revenue attribution. We use advanced tracking and analytics tools to provide transparent, data-driven insights. You'll also have access to a client dashboard for real-time performance monitoring.

What if I'm not satisfied with the results?

We offer a 90-day satisfaction guarantee. If you don't see at least 200% ROI within 90 days, we'll either continue working at no cost until you do, or provide a full refund. We're so confident in our methods because we've consistently delivered results for our clients over the years.

Do you offer month-to-month services or require annual contracts?

We offer both options. Month-to-month agreements provide maximum flexibility, while annual contracts receive a 15% discount and priority support. Most clients choose 6-12 month agreements for the best balance of commitment and results. There are no cancellation fees, though we ask for 30 days notice if you decide to discontinue services.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards, ACH/bank transfers, and wire transfers for larger clients. Payment is typically due on the 1st of each month, with invoicing sent 5 days prior. We also offer net-30 terms for qualified businesses and can set up automatic recurring payments for your convenience.

Getting Started

How do I get started with Lumyx?

Getting started is simple: 1) Schedule your free strategy call, 2) We'll analyze your current situation and create a custom plan, 3) If it's a good fit, we'll start implementation within 1-2 weeks. The entire process from first call to campaign launch typically takes 7-14 days.

What information do you need from me to get started?

We'll need access to your current marketing accounts (Google Ads, Analytics, social media), information about your target audience, business goals, and any existing marketing materials. Don't worry if you don't have everything set up - we can help create and optimize accounts as needed.

Can you work with my existing marketing team?

Absolutely! We often collaborate with in-house marketing teams, providing specialized expertise in areas like PPC management or SEO while your team focuses on other initiatives. We're flexible and can adapt our services to complement your existing resources and workflows.

Do you work with startups or only established businesses?

We work with both! For early-stage startups, we offer streamlined packages focused on quick wins and lean budgets. For established businesses, we provide comprehensive strategies for scaling. The key requirement is having a validated product/service and budget to invest in growth. We'll assess your current stage during the strategy call and recommend the best path forward.

What makes a good fit for your agency?

Ideal clients are growth-focused businesses with proven products/services, realistic marketing budgets ($3,000+/month), willingness to implement recommendations, and commitment to at least 3-6 months for meaningful results. We work best with businesses that value data-driven decisions, transparent communication, and are ready to scale. If you're looking for quick fixes or unrealistic overnight results, we're probably not the right fit.
